data.gender_notes: Raitah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The soft rain that soothes the earth and brings new life to it, gentle and nurturing. The name Raitah carries the meaning “Gentleness, Soft Rain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Raitah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentleness, soft rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is a rain of blessings and kindness, a gentle soul who nurtures and brings life to others.
data.etymology: Raitah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentleness, Soft Rain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raitah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Hisham, Sirah Rasul Allah, p. 527 The name Raitah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Raitah was the name of a well-known woman of the Banu Amir tribe who was known for her generosity and hospitality. She was a close companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and was one of the earliest converts to Islam. She provided shelter and food to the Prophet and his companions during their early days in Mecca.

trends: used as a given name for girls
